hooks.name: Spec-consistency reminder
hooks.description: When requirements.md or design.md is edited, remind the agent to keep the spec triplet and implementation consistent.

action.prompt: A ShipCheck spec file (requirements.md or design.md) was just edited. Check that the three spec documents stay consistent: every requirement clause referenced in design.md and tasks.md still exists, each of the 34 correctness properties still maps to a requirement, and tasks.md still covers the changed scope. Flag any requirement, design property, or task that is now orphaned or contradicted, and confirm the pure-core / advisor-non-authoritative invariants still hold.
